name: fivem-cache-cleanup
title: Clear FiveM Client Cache
description: Removes temporary FiveM cache files (keeps game storage). FiveM must be closed; cached server assets may need to download again.
deepDescription:
MAINTENANCE
Clears temporary files from the default FiveM client cache folder and preserves the game and game-storage folders. FiveM and GTA V must be closed.

This can help troubleshoot some client loading issues or reclaim cache disk space. It is not an FPS boost; FiveM may need to download cached server assets again. This does not remove account, character, or server-side data.
modal: Close FiveM and GTA V first. This removes temporary client cache files; some server assets may download again the next time you join. Game and game-storage folders are preserved.
